comparison.objective: Transfer a wafer from lift pins into a cassette slot, versus commissioning an adjustable axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Fragile planar pickup, transport, and slot insertion versus hex-key engagement, counterholding, collar rotation, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer placement is title-implied; the record supplies no body, specs, tolerances, or damage rubric. Candidate requires two repeatable non-bottoming dynamic stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: The tested transfer/insertion ability is meaningfully different from tuning and mechanically locking a damper; shared alignment is only generic.
